description: Returns current artifact HTML, echoes its current version id, and flags whether it differs from a requested snapshot's version_ref.id. include_targets optionally includes projection targets for anchor resolution. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

expected_version_ref.description: Version ref or version id expected by the caller.

include_targets.description: Include projection targets for stable-anchor resolution.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot whose version should be compared.

name: get_artifact
